chunks: And that which Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Ali ibn Asbat from Durust from 'Ajlān Abū Ṣāliḥ, that he heard Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him) saying:

"When a woman performs 'Umrah, then falls ill before she performs the Tawaf, she advances her Sa'i and performs the Manasik. When she is purified and returns from Hajj, she makes up the Tawaf of 'Umrah, the Tawaf of Hajj, and the Tawaf of the Women, then she becomes permissible from everything." This is not contradictory to the first report because it is not understood from his saying (peace be upon him) 'then she fell ill before she performed the Tawaf' that she had not performed the entire Tawaf or part of it; rather, it is possible that he meant before she completed the Tawaf. And when this possibility is held, we interpret it as her having performed part of the Tawaf, even exceeding the half mark. And his saying (peace be upon him) 'then she made up the Tawaf of 'Umrah' means the completion of the Tawaf of 'Umrah, not the entire Tawaf. And there is no contradiction between the reports. And that which indicates what we mentioned is what was narrated:

key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: Tawaf al-Nisa' (Tawaf of the Women, a specific ritual)
key_terms.قَضَتْ: Qada (to make up for a missed obligation)

ai.seo_question: What should a woman do if she falls ill during 'Umrah before completing the Tawaf?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* details the specific ritual adjustments for a woman who falls ill during 'Umrah before completing the Tawaf, requiring her to perform Sa'i and Manasik before returning from Hajj to make up the missing Tawaf components. Shaykh al-Tusi uses this report to resolve an apparent contradiction with another hadith by interpreting the phrase 'before she performed the Tawaf' as 'before she completed the Tawaf,' thereby allowing for partial completion. This scholarly reconciliation highlights the precision of Shia fiqh in handling exceptions to ritual obligations based on the stage of completion.
